title: crypto-coin
description: cripto Mod adds new items: BTC_coin (Bitcoin), ETH_coin (Ethereum), and USDT_coin (Tether) and more.
body:
cripto Mod adds three new items: BTC_coin (Bitcoin), ETH_coin (Ethereum), and USDT_coin (Tether).

None of these items can be crafted and they have no recipes. They can only be obtained through Creative Mode inventory or using commands (e.g. /give).

All three coins are intended for testing, creative builds, or custom server setups where manual item control is required — such as simulated economies or financial systems.

No survival progression is affected, and the mod does not add any additional mechanics beyond the coin items themselves.
